notes.title: Patch 0.2.78
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283598/5ea5743d5060519b70b45ca9189bab2f48c0c2ee.png

New Features:

 Added a voice chat feature! Now you can communicate with allies directly in the game, using Push-to-Talk or Voice Activation at your discretion!
 Added a cooldown indicator for abilities
 The abilities selection window has been redesigned! Now, choosing new abilities occurs on the right side of the screen and has a more compact look
 Added an option to select abilities using the keys "1/2/3/4"
 Added an option to view all ability combinations, activated using the "ALT" key
 Added an option to display ping in the server list
 Redesigned the "Controls" section in the game settings
 Added a portal icon display on the minimap for the "Accursed Citadel" location

Fixes and Improvements:

 Improved mouse controls
 Fixed the display of statistics at the end of a match
 Fixed the display of the player's progress bar
 Made minor UI fixes
 Made minor fixes to the display of some ability effects
 Made minor fixes to the "Accursed Citadel" scene
 Fixed the subtitles for the cutscene after victory in the "Accursed Citadel" location
 Changed the build compilation method to improve game performance

notes.title: Update 0.2.77.2
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Added a shared experience gain mode! This option can be activated in the map selection menu
 Added Steam Cloud synchronization
 Added sound cues for keys in the "Accursed Citadel" location. Now, if you are near a key, you will hear a magical sound indicating that you are on the right path


Additionally, we fixed several bugs:

 Fixed a critical error that caused the game to crash in the "Accursed Citadel" location
 Fixed an issue where two identical weapons could drop
 Fixed an issue with the "Mummy" boss where the boss could disappear
 Now, the "Chest" item you pick up is guaranteed to give you gold
 Slightly improved network connectivity

notes.title: New Update! We heard your Feedback
notes.notes:
Dear players, we heard your feedback ! 
We've greatly improved the auto-aim to make the game more fun and rebalanced the gold economy so you can unlock more content faster

We're commited to improving this game update after update during Early Access. Keep giving us feedback!

Here are the more detailed patch notes:

Update 0.2.77.1
New Features:

 The "Herculean Punch" ability now deals damage not only in front of the player but also behind them
 Added mouse cursor control. You can click on the screen to issue movement commands or hold down the right mouse button to continuously move around the location
 Added auto-closing of pop-up windows when opening achievements
 Increased the chance of a chest drop in the "Forgotten Forest" location and in the "Accursed Citadel"
 Increased gold coin income
 Added a coin icon on the minimap
 Now, if the group leader has unlocked a new location and other group members have not, you can still play together in the location that is locked for you
 Increased the size of the tentacles in rage mode for the character "Lyrissa"
 Changed the logic for the weapons "Fireball" and "Rasen Shuriken". Now, these weapons have a 50% chance to attack the first encountered enemy and a 50% chance to attack in a random direction. Previously, these weapons only had random shooting directions


Additionally, we fixed several bugs:

 Fixed an issue where the player or enemies could get stuck in a barrel in the "Accursed Citadel" location
 Fixed the offline mode, now you are guaranteed to be able to play even with the internet disconnected
 Fixed an issue with selecting the character "Ashlyn" in the main menu
 Fixed an issue with obtaining the "Battle Roar" achievement
 Fixed an issue where pressing "Esc" would bring up the exit game window instead of closing the settings window
 Reduced the hitboxes for taking damage for the character
 Made localization fixes

notes.title: Steam Next Fest development update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for your valuable feedback and bug reports. We greatly appreciate your input as we actively develop our demo. Your recommendations are invaluable, and we are committed to enhancing the game's balance, stability, and overall enjoyment.

In our upcoming early access version in November, expect numerous fixes and exciting additions. This includes the ability to modify weapons by combining passive and active items, unique stats for each hero, and the exciting concept of hero soul modification - all of which will be part of the final release version.

Moreover, you can look forward to diverse map types, including dungeons, team tasks, and exploration missions. Our sound design will receive further refinement, and we're dedicated to fine-tuning the game's balance to achieve the optimal difficulty ratio. Your support is crucial to our development journey, and we can't wait to provide you with an even better gaming experience.

Tune in to our livestream currently too and feel free to ask us any questions in the community group. We have several videos going live from influencers including reviews, let's plays and a special featuring on Friday so stay tuned!
